title: SDP methods metadata schema
description: Optional registry of procedures associated with measurements in the package.

fields.name: method_iri
fields.description: Absolute IRI identifying a procedure resource, interpreted as a sosa:Procedure.

fields.name: method_description
fields.description: Description sufficient to distinguish the procedure and understand its role.

fields.name: method_version
fields.description: Version, edition, or date label for the procedure when applicable.

fields.name: protocol_iri
fields.description: Absolute IRI for a protocol, standard operating procedure, or other normative method document.

fields.name: citation
fields.description: Bibliographic citation or concise source attribution for the procedure.

sdp:rowRule: One row per procedure described by this package. A method is a SOSA procedure association, not an I-ADOPT variable component.
